newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank has no comment on Midshires.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank has no comment on Midshires.

text.p: The Royal Bank of Scotland Plc on Tuesday declined to comment on renewed press speculation it was discussing a merger with the Birmingham Midshires Building Society.
Earlier, Midshires, announcing its first half results, said it had made no decision on changing its corporate form but added it was looking at possibilities "with an open mind."
Press reports have said the Royal Bank would offer Birmingham Midshires 650 million stg for a merger, giving the society's 1.2 million members a windfall of more than 500 stg each.
Last week, the society suspended new account openings saying it had been swamped by speculators opening accounts in order to receive a windfall.
Birmingham Midshires has assets of just over seven billion stg.
Royal Bank has made no secret of the fact that it would like to buy or merge with a building society to improve its product distribution in the English market.
But its chief executive George Mathewson has also said that the price of such assets is very high at the moment.
